title: Lucpack Survival
description: Lucpack, Survival Modpack, Singleplayer and Multiplayer support, Content Creator
body:
🎉 **Lucpack is Now LIVE!** 🎉

The ultimate performance & PvP-optimized modpack for **Minecraft 1.21.10** 🚀  
Smooth gameplay, clean visuals, and powerful quality-of-life features — all without shaders.

## 🔥 What’s Included?

🚀 **Massive FPS Boost**
• Sodium  
• Lithium  
• ImmediatelyFast  
• FerriteCore  

🗺️ **World Map & Minimap**
• Xaero's Minimap  
• Xaero's World Map  

⚡ **PvP Optimizations**
• Zoomify  
• NotEnoughAnimations  
• Immersive Hotbar  
• Centered Crosshair  

🎨 **Enhanced Visuals (No Shaders)**
• MoreCulling  
• Continuity  
• 3D Skin Layers  
• Invisible Frames  

🧠 **Utility & Building Tools**
• Litematica  
• WorldEdit  
• Shulker Tooltips  
• Pickup Notifications  
• SearchStats  

🎙️ **Voice Chat Included**
• Simple Voice Chat  

## ⚙️ Technical Info

• Version: 1.21.10 (Fabric)  
• Recommended RAM: 4GB  
• Multiplayer Optimized  
• PvP Ready  

🔥 Download Lucpack now and experience Minecraft smoother than ever! 🔥
